//: REDUCING THE GOLD LUMP.  Mirrors the base game's own gold-form deconstruction (data/json/uncraft/resources/metal.json:190-197, where a 1 L gold ingot uncrafts into 1000 gold_small with a hammer and a saw).  This is what makes the lump usable in every recipe that wants gold - base and mod alike - without editing a single recipe.
//2: WHY AN UNCRAFT RATHER THAN A RECIPE COMPONENT.  Base recipes name gold_small directly (e.g. gold_ring, gold_necklace, crown_golden_survivor, the shot loads), and a mod cannot extend a recipe's components: recipe 'components' are loaded through item_components, which has no extend handling (unlike 'using' requirements, which aftershock_exoplanet does extend).  Adding the lump to those recipes would therefore mean duplicating each recipe wholesale.  Reducing the lump to gold_small is the base game's own answer for a new gold form.
//3: THE YIELD FOLLOWS THE LUMP.  One serving of molten gold sets into a 2500 g lump, and gold_small is 19 g each, so 130 is a ~1.2% loss - the same order as the base game's own ingot reduction (a 1 L ingot is 19320 g into 1000 gold_small, ~1.7%).  If the lump's weight changes, tests/scp_294_test.cpp fails first; this number is the thing to update with it.
